Heading: Noto Sans JP 700, 64-80px; Body: Noto Sans JP 500, 32-40px; Mono: Suisse Int'l Mono for source chips; Line-height: 1.5

brief.palette: Background #fefcf5, Surface #eaeae2, Text #3c3a39, Muted #666962, Primary #2677ff, Accent #b5510a
brief.typography: Heading: Noto Sans JP 700, 64-80px; Body: Noto Sans JP 500, 32-40px; Mono: Suisse Int'l Mono for source chips; Line-height: 1.5
brief.motion: Duration: 300-500ms; Easing: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); Type: Fade and short slide, staggered reveals
brief.layout: 1920x1080 canvas; Logo fixed in top-right corner on all scenes; Headline centered or left-aligned with 2-3 supporting points below; Source chips aligned to supporting points; Final scene centers logo, CTA, and URL
notes: Use Noto Sans JP for all Japanese text with weight 700 for headlines and 500 for body; never break Japanese words across lines.
Display source chips (e.g., 'Tavily Product') next to each supporting point using the brand's primary color #2677ff for text or background.
Ensure the logo remains visible in a corner on every scene and the final scene ends with the logo, a call-to-action button, and the URL.
Apply staggered reveals to supporting points with a 300-500ms delay between elements to maintain a calm, precise rhythm.
Maintain generous margins and ensure high information density by including at least two supporting points per scene alongside the headline.
Avoid bouncing or exaggerated effects; use only fades and short slides to align with the professional, technical tone.
